subject: Small note on the order of tasks
text: Hi, I wanted to mention a small issue so it does not become confusing later. When we compared notes after the first session, I realized we had slightly different ideas about the order of the tasks. I had understood that we would begin with the filing work, because it seemed quickest, but your notes indicated that the email drafts should come first. That is not a major problem, and it is easy to correct now, but I thought it was better to point it out directly. Since you are new to this arrangement, I do not want you to think I am questioning your priorities. I simply want us both to know which approach you prefer before we spend another hour working side by side. If the filing work can wait, then that is what I will focus on. If you would rather see the drafts first, I can move everything else back by a short time. Either way is workable for me, and I appreciate that we can talk through it without making it awkward. If it helps, I can create a simple checklist in our shared folder tomorrow morning. That way we can mark what is complete, note anything still pending, and avoid a repeat of today’s small mix-up. I can also bring my own notes to our next check-in, so we can compare them openly and adjust anything that looks unclear. Please feel free to tell me if there is another detail I should watch for as well.
